description: DNS of the unstable Re=1950 limit cycle (orbit plus a small part of the leading Floquet mode), compared with the Floquet pair of ../311_stability_direct_floquet. plot.py fits the once-per-period deviation of the probe and writes floquet_vs_dns.dat. The two relative errors are pass criteria (growth rate within 20 %, frequency within 5 %); the DNS growth rate is a regression value of this repository, not a literature value.
